title: Blue Hour and Language
author: Wendell Montrose
blurb: Zephyrine Halloran, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
